question: Should OpenClaw ship Discord-specific source-message subagent progress with this seven-control configuration surface and shared lifecycle callback?
rationale: The PR adds a new user-facing mode plus permanent public config and plugin lifecycle contracts; code review can repair correctness but cannot determine product sponsorship or the desired initial surface size.

options.title: Adopt after repair
options.body: Accept the feature after per-tracker serialization, focused regression coverage, exact-head Discord proof, and upgrade review.

options.title: Narrow the first contract
options.body: Keep the feature but reduce the configurable controls and shared lifecycle surface before shipping.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause or close the PR until broader cross-channel subagent observability direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Adopt after repair
recommendation.body: Accept the feature after per-tracker serialization, focused regression coverage, exact-head Discord proof, and upgrade review.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows the strongest combined ownership of Discord channel behavior, plugin boundaries, and channel lifecycle contracts.
